critique: The t4 frame now has the essential preset look: crisp flat mint/green triangular sprites on black, with a clearly expanding, screen-spanning geometric particle field. Motion is substantially improved from t1’s compact cluster to t4’s wide dispersion. However, the t4 field is still overly concentrated and overlapped through the center, while many peripheral triangles are disproportionately large. This reads more like a burst from one point than the cleaner, individually legible scattered-triangle composition suggested by the Triangles 2D thumbnail.

suggestions.why: Reduce maximum triangle scale so central particles separate visually and the broad field reads as many distinct geometric elements rather than overlapping large shards.
Slightly reduce the sustained particle density; this preserves the expansive motion while making the field less congested at later times.
